description: Searches the authenticated workspace customers without exposing addresses, notes, or other private fields. Use to search customers in the connected business. Returns query, count, customers, id, name, email, phone, business_name, trade_type, lifecycle_tag, scope.

limit.description: Maximum number of customers to return.

query.description: Name, email, phone, or business name to search for.

name: search-customers

count.description: Number of customers returned in this bounded result.

customers.description: Safe customer contact and lifecycle fields; excludes addresses and notes.

query.description: Search text, or null when no query was supplied.

scope.description: Results belong to the business bound to this OAuth connection.

title: Search Customers Tool
